entries.title: Butterfly from Big Shapes
entries.summary: Build a friendly butterfly from one long body, four big wings and a pair of matching spots, then fill it with color.

entries.title: Observational Butterfly
entries.summary: Study the butterfly's center, wing contours, vein directions and edge texture to make a more observational drawing.

entries.title: Butterfly Pattern Play
entries.summary: Build a balanced butterfly, repeat a few mirrored marks, then invent extra wing patterns of your own.

entries.title: Butterfly Symmetry & Proportion
entries.summary: Use a center axis, compare wing sizes and layer a few vein lines to build a more controlled butterfly.

entries.title: Create Your Character
entries.summary: Combine silhouette, expression, outfit shapes and story choices to design a character that belongs to you.

entries.title: Cute Cat
entries.summary: Draw a friendly cat from simple curves, ears, face details and a body with a tail.

entries.title: Design Your Spaceship
entries.summary: Learn a sturdy spaceship foundation, then choose, combine or invent details that make the final design unmistakably yours.

entries.title: Easy Flower
entries.summary: Build a cheerful flower from a round center, a whole group of petals, then a stem and leaves.

entries.title: Elephant From Shapes
entries.summary: Build a large elephant from simple connected forms, then use overlap and proportion to make the body feel solid before adding your own character details.

entries.title: Face & Expressions
entries.summary: Build a simple face with clear landmarks, then change the features to create an expression that feels like yours.

entries.title: Fox Portrait
entries.summary: Practice proportion, placement and refined details while building a thoughtful front-facing fox portrait.

entries.title: Friendly Alien
entries.summary: Build a clear alien silhouette, balance a few features, then change the parts, expression and story until the character feels like yours.

entries.title: Friendly Owl
entries.summary: Build a warm little owl from an oval body, balanced eyes, curved wings, a beak and tiny feet.

entries.title: Happy Lines
entries.summary: Practice big straight, curvy, zigzag and looping lines, then turn your favorite marks into something of your own.

entries.title: Hot Air Balloon
entries.summary: Build a floating balloon from one big shape, simple panel lines and a basket, then explore bold color combinations.

entries.title: Ice Cream Shop
entries.summary: Build a playful ice-cream stand from simple shapes, then invent toppings, patterns and sign details that make the shop yours.

entries.title: Little Fish
entries.summary: Turn an oval, two simple triangles and a tiny face into a cheerful fish, then bring it to life with color.

entries.title: One-Point Room
entries.summary: Use a horizon, one vanishing point and converging edges to build a room with believable depth, then design the space your way.

entries.title: Planet With Rings
entries.summary: Build a centered planet, make its rings pass behind and in front, then invent the world’s own surface, moons and mood.

entries.title: Rainbow Weather
entries.summary: Build a roomy rainbow scene, add balanced clouds, choose your own weather details, then color three broad rainbow bands.

entries.title: Sailboat Scene
entries.summary: Construct a sailboat, then use horizon, overlap and scale to place it inside a balanced water scene rather than drawing the boat alone.

entries.title: Shape Friends
entries.summary: Practice a circle, square and triangle, combine them into a simple friend, then choose your own details.

entries.title: Simple Body & Pose
entries.summary: Construct a simple figure with clear body proportions, then use direction and balance to give the pose more life.

entries.title: Simple Car
entries.summary: Build a clear car from one long body, a smaller cabin and two wheels, then change the design to make it yours.

entries.title: Simple Rocket
entries.summary: Watch a rocket come together, then draw it yourself from a tall body, balanced fins and a bright flame.

entries.title: Smiling Sun
entries.summary: Trace and draw a bright sun from one big circle, simple rays and a happy face.

entries.title: Snail Garden
entries.summary: Build a friendly snail with one flowing shell, then place it in a tiny garden and invent your own patterns and details.

entries.title: Tree Through Seasons
entries.summary: Build an organic tree from trunk, branches and loose canopy shapes, then choose seasonal details that tell your own story.
